# 安全与隐私需求质量 Checklist: 屏幕录制器 (Screen Recorder)

**Purpose**: 验证屏幕捕获的隐私边界、录制文件留存、应用自身窗口排除与数据安全等需求是否明确
**Created**: 2026-10-18
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 - Is user awareness of active screen capture specified (tray state indicator, notification, or equivalent)? [Gap, Spec §FR-002, §FR-009]
- [ ] CHK002 - Is a data retention/cleanup policy for recordings, settings, and crash markers defined? [Gap]
- [ ] CHK003 - Is the requirement to exclude the application's own windows from the capturable window list stated? [Gap, Spec §FR-008]
- [ ] CHK004 - Are the privacy boundaries of window capture (other windows, notifications, overlays) explained in requirements? [Gap, Spec §FR-008]
- [ ] CHK005 - Are requirements for recording-file storage permissions and sensitive locations specified? [Gap, Spec §FR-017]
- [ ] CHK006 - Is the crash-marker file's content and cleanup specified to avoid leaking file paths or session data? [Gap, Spec Edge Cases]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK007 - Is "不录制音频" unambiguous about both system sound and microphone? [Clarity, Spec §FR-014]
- [ ] CHK008 - Is the screen-capture consent model defined (no OS prompt on Windows; app-level notice)? [Clarity, Gap]
- [ ] CHK009 - Is the single-session requirement (§FR-013) justified as a safety property (no duplicate capture) rather than only a UX rule? [Clarity, Spec §FR-013]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK010 - Do "record only the selected target" requirements agree across fullscreen, region, and window modes? [Consistency, Spec §FR-005–§FR-008]
- [ ] CHK011 - Do the edge cases for window occlusion/minimization preserve user privacy expectations consistently? [Consistency, Spec Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK012 - Does the no-audio rule remain consistent with the settings requirements (no audio toggle configured)? [Consistency, Spec §FR-014, §FR-016]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK013 - Can "no silent data loss" (§FR-012) be objectively verified? [Measurability, Spec §FR-012]
- [ ] CHK014 - Is the crash-recovery notification behavior (message content, file reporting) testable as written? [Measurability, Spec Edge Cases]

## Scenario Coverage

- [ ] CHK015 - Are requirements defined for recording screens containing passwords or other sensitive data (disclaimer vs prevention)? [Gap, Edge Case]
- [ ] CHK016 - Are requirements defined for removable/network storage targets that may disconnect during recording? [Gap]
- [ ] CHK017 - Are requirements defined for multi-user machines (settings isolation, shared output folders)? [Gap]

## Non-Functional & Assumptions

- [ ] CHK018 - Is the assumption documented that no administrator rights or special Windows capture permissions are required? [Assumption]
- [ ] CHK019 - Is the offline/no-network requirement recorded and linked to data-egress expectations? [Consistency, Spec Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK020 - Is the threat model (local single-user app, no remote content) documented to justify the security baseline? [Traceability, Gap]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`
- Add comments or findings inline
- Link to relevant resources or documentation
- Items are numbered sequentially for easy reference
